title: /api/report-audio-upload
responsibility: Accepts a same-origin audio upload, validates its form and preserves audio-specific error responses.

inputs.name: POST.request
inputs.description: The incoming Request destructured from the POST argument; it is passed to admitUploadRequest with url.origin and 51_000_000 before request.formData() reads the body. A truthy admitUploadRequest result is returned directly, so the body is read only when that result is falsy.

inputs.name: POST.url
inputs.description: The URL destructured from the POST argument; only url.origin is read, and it is passed to admitUploadRequest as its second argument before any body is read. The path and query are not used anywhere in this file.

outputs.name: POST
outputs.description: Resolves to a 201 JSON response of the report from the AudioUploadService upload call (Cache-Control: no-store) on success, or, when admitUploadRequest returns a truthy value, to that value unchanged. Exceptions inside the try block become JSON {error} responses: 409 when the message contains 'finaliz', 404 'Report not found' when it contains 'ENOENT', 400 with the message when it matches /audio|format|WAV|title|size/i, and otherwise 500 'Audio upload failed; no evidence was added'.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown inside POST when the 'audio' form field is missing or is not a File instance. POST's catch block turns it into a 400 JSON {error: 'Choose an audio file'} response, so POST resolves rather than rejecting with it.
